newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Aug 19.
newsitem.headline: Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Aug 19.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:
* Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd A$17.10 (-0.39)

Chile's Minera Escondida Ltda said on Monday it had produced 63,233 tonnes of copper in July and a total of 543,581 tonnes in the first seven months of 1997, a rise of 11.2 percent on a year ago. BHP is expected to release its monthly production report later in the next few days.
* John Fairfax Holdings Ltd A$3.19 (unch)

Newspaper publisher John Fairfax Holdings Ltd is expected to report late on Tuesday that slow economic growth and advertising volumes through late 1996 pushed net profit down about about 11 percent in the 1996/97 year. Analysts' forecasts for Fairfax's net profit before abnormals range from A$75.1 million to A$99.4 million, with a median forecast of A$90.3 million, according to BZW's Barceps survey.
* Capral Aluminium Ltd A$4.45 (-0.07)
Capral Aluminium to report its interim results.
* Perpetual Trustees A$9.70 (+0.15)
Perpetual to release its full year results.
CSL is expected to post annual results. It has said it expected second half net profit growth to slow from the 35 percent seen in the first half.
* North Flinders Mines A$6.70 (-0.02)
* Mt Leyshon Gold Mines Ltd A$1.65 (unch)
Mt Leyshon and North Flinders are exected to post annual results.
* Australian Provincial News Ltd A$2.16 (-0.04)

APN is due to report interim results, with a net profit before abnormals of about A$11 million to A$13 million. APN has said it expected higher profits in the 1997 year than the A$26.54 million profit in 1996.
* Boral Ltd A$3.83 (-0.07)
The A$350 million offer of stapled securities in Boral Ltd's gas distribution spinoff, Envestra Ltd, has been fully subscribed, Envestra said on Monday.
* Infrastructure Trust of Australia A$1.32 (-0.03)

The Infrastructure Trust of Australia said on Monday it had committed to invest A$143.1 million in the Airport Motorway, a consortium which has the concession to build and operate the the Eastern Distributor tollway project in Sydney for 48 years.
* Santos Ltd A$6.47 (-0.11)

Oil and gas producer Santos Ltd said on Monday it discovered two new gas fields from wildcat wells drilled in the Nappacoongee-Murteree block in the South Australian section of the onshore Cooper/Eromanga Basins. Milluna-1 flowed gas at 7.45 million cubic per day over the interval 2209-2223 metres while Bauhaus-1 flowed gas at 0.84 million cubic feet per day over the interval 2699-2708 metres, Santos said.
* Metal Manufactures Ltd A$2.85 (unch)
Standard & Poors said on Monday it had lowered its long-term rating on Metal Manufactures Ltd to BBB-plus from A-minus and had affirmed its A-2 short-term rating.
-- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373 1800
